output.reason: The validators prove that status.artifact.digest becomes required in the Bucket v1beta2 schema between the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 bundles [ev-782bc47d120d, ev-c2c6c790d6b2]. However, the excerpts show only "apiVersion: v1", and the "objects that omit them are rejected" wording is the computed diff's generic text. This is a status field, and a required field inside status.artifact is only checked when status.artifact is present, so "any Bucket omitting the digest is rejected" is broader than the schema implies. Nothing shown says whether existing stored objects or the upgraded controller's status writes are rejected, so a mandatory resource-rejected consequence is not established. Release notes or upgrade-guide text on the effect for existing v1beta2 Buckets is needed.
